authority: Static shipped-artifact analysis; native GUI and tests are separate evidence

limitations: Derived by an REA composed workflow.
Cancelling an active Ghidra request terminates its ephemeral database and discards session annotations. The selected target remains open; the next provider query imports the original artifact again.
DOS MZ uses 16-bit x86 real mode with the Ghidra load segment 0x1000. Returned addresses are linear byte coordinates; they do not identify a unique segment:offset alias.
Default-space addresses use lowercase 0x-prefixed hexadecimal; other address spaces use <percent-encoded-space>:0x<hex>.
External functions and functions without an analyzable body return null; other decompiler failures remain explicit.
External functions and local thunks are distinct; procedure metadata identifies both and preserves a thunk target when Ghidra resolves one.
Pseudocode is Ghidra decompiler output, not original source and not text-equivalent to Hopper output.

Static DOS analysis does not emulate BIOS, DOS interrupts, device ports, or self-modifying unpacking code. Packed targets require a separately identified unpacked artifact for original-program analysis; appended overlays are not the initialized load module.
The imported Program and temporary project are ephemeral and deleted on close. Annotation operations edit session database metadata; original executable bytes are never written.
The session serves operations only after Ghidra reports default auto-analysis complete; incomplete analysis does not expose partial results.
macOS sessions require a matching executable Ghidra native decompiler; REA checks for it but does not build native components or change Gatekeeper quarantine state.

nativeAdaptations: Existing native names remain up to32 Unicode characters; new original-style entries use8 ASCII slots
Native member counts above10 are paginated; new original-style entries require fewer than10 active members
Removed profiles and separate session files are retained and can be restored from a native Game menu command
Confirmation and restore dialogs use macOS controls
General BIOS buffering, exact driver palette/masks and final complete playthrough remain unverified
